changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO room_version (room_id, version, operation, data, db_user, client_app) SELECT r.id, r.row_version, 'BASELINE', to_jsonb(r), current_user, current_setting('application_name') FROM room r

changeSet.author: smilezevil
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION room_restore_version(p_room_id BIGINT, p_version INT) RETURNS INT LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ DECLARE snapshot room; new_version INT; BEGIN SELECT * INTO snapshot FROM jsonb_populate_record(NULL::room, (SELECT data FROM room_version WHERE room_id = p_room_id AND version = p_version)); IF snapshot.id IS NULL THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Версії % для кімнати % немає', p_version, p_room_id; END IF; UPDATE room SET hotel_id = snapshot.hotel_id, room_number = snapshot.room_number, type = snapshot.type, price_per_night = snapshot.price_per_night, capacity = snapshot.capacity, updated_at = LOCALTIMESTAMP, updated_by = 'db:restore-v' || p_version WHERE id = p_room_id RETURNING row_version INTO new_version; RETURN new_version; END $$

changeSet.author: smilezevil
changeSet.sql: CREATE TRIGGER room_row_version_before BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON room FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION room_next_row_version()
CREATE TRIGGER room_version_after AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON room FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION room_save_version()
